title: Inference gateway: bring your own Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google keys (direct adapters for pay: mine)
body:
Follow-up from #11067. Bring your own key on the API is built for OpenRouter and Vercel AI Gateway keys (sealed per workspace, pay: mine routes only to them). Anthropic (Messages API), OpenAI (Responses, native), and Google (Gemini API / Vertex with the user's credential) need adapters in crates/inference/src/upstream before their keys can be accepted; until then the provider-keys routes refuse them.

Spec: docs/inference/gateway.md section 4 (User keys row) and section 13, P1 bring your own key as built.
